findings.passage: If you have a prolific scorer, the best way to stop him is not to wait for him to get the ball, but to keep him from getting the ball.
findings.note: Quoted by a news story at a House committee hearing on bills widening concealed carry (HB 328) and limiting red-flag seizures (HB 434, HB 459). Smith called the carry bill tone-deaf given mass shootings; the analogy was about the idea that a good guy with a gun is the best way to stop a bad guy. Hearing date approximate (story dated 2025-01-31).
subjects: more guns as protection against shooters
